RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel may violate university procedural rules; many public institutions mandate gender balance on hiring committees. However, the panel's composition alone does not prove discrimination. Committees frequently weigh specific industry experience, departmental curriculum fit, and interview performance over raw publication metrics. 

First, follow up professionally with HR regarding your delayed feedback. Review the institution's hiring regulations to see whether panel diversity guidelines were breached. If explicit rules were broken, you can raise a legitimate procedural inquiry with HR or the ombudsman. Otherwise, alleging sex discrimination without documented criteria or written feedback risks harming your professional reputation in a close-knit academic field. Wait for the formal rationale before deciding to escalate.
